texts.en:
The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters from the tangled web of their minds.

If they did not understand before, they know now viscerally: we are all part of something greater.

# 强制改信 / Faith Enforced

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/planet_destruction_events.txt:1112-1377; common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:73-75 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家用巨像的“天神裁决”武器毁掉/改造一颗行星时（common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:73-75），隐藏事件触发；若星球有所有者且不是自己，所有者的对手即玩家获得叙事窗口 planet_destruction.401。

When the player's Colossus fires "Divine Enforcer" at a planet (common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:73-75) the hidden dispatcher fires; if the planet has an owner that is not the firing country, a narrative window planet_destruction.401 is shown to the firing player. 

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口 planet_destruction.401，每个国家只显示一次（国家旗标 fired_godray）。若星球上有观测前哨，一天后另有 planet_destruction.1000 通知；若是机械意识（Contingency）的世界则触发 crisis.2040/2046（属危机故事）。

A single window planet_destruction.401, shown once per country (country flag fired_godray). If the planet had an observation outpost, planet_destruction.1000 follows one day later; Contingency machine worlds trigger crisis.2040/2046 (crisis stories).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无条件差异。

No variants.
